svg.text: 3D CAD Model 13: Central Keel + 2 Staggered U-Foils + 4 Tip Floats + Dry Tie-Bars
12–15.5 kn Cruise (WL Z = -510 mm): All 4 Corner Floats +30 mm DRY & Tie-Bars +330 mm DRY • 2 Staggered Foils Deep Underwater!
4× Corner Tip Floats (24 L Ea. = 96 L)
Top: torpedo • Side: rounded rect (620×400 mm) — 4-pt stability!
Locks front & rear floats (+330 mm in air = 0 N drag) + dock rail
Front Main U-Foil (65% Lift, 320 mm Deep)
Thin 18 mm blade + anti-vent fence • Only blades wet @ 12–15 kn
Single 28 L Central Keel Pod (0 Torps!)
5.38 kWh pack in 1 pod • ~100 kgf total 0 kn pre-lift buoyancy
Lowers all 4 floats 75% underwater at 0 kn for ~5 kn takeoff
Wet @ 6–10 kn (pitch+roll stable) → +30 mm DRY @ 12–15.5 kn!
35% lift clean above front wake • Replaces aft stab • ±35 cm CoG
Twin Fixed Ø108 mm Rear Pump-Jets
132.5 cm² exit • 0 moving tail parts • ~33 nm @ 12 kn!
